summary: This stylesheet defines styling for a project setup container UI component. It creates a bordered box with a styled header, scrollable content area, and various helper classes for displaying tips, errors, and button groups.

explanations.2: Uses a CSS variable for the border color, which gets its value from the design system's emphasis color palette.
explanations.5: Hides any content that extends beyond the container's edges, preventing it from spilling out.
explanations.10: Applies a light background color using a design system variable to visually distinguish the header from the content below.
explanations.11: Enables flexbox layout, which allows the header to arrange its children in a row.
explanations.12: Spreads child elements to opposite ends of the header (typically a title on the left and action buttons on the right).
explanations.21: Limits the script container to 400 pixels tall and creates a scrollbar if the content is longer.
explanations.22: When content exceeds the max-height, this enables scrolling within just that container instead of the whole page.
explanations.30: Colors the error text using the design system's danger color (typically red) to signal a problem.
